test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 14 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.

He lights his pipe, (and on many an evenings he helps me with) dishes.

options.text: and many an evenings he helps me with the
and on many evenings he helps me with the
and on many evenings he helped me with the

solution:
The correct answer is "**and on many evenings he helps me with the.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the given sentence, the error lies in the usage of the article "an" in front of the plural noun "evenings."**

 
 
• **We use "an" before a singular noun starting with the vowel sound.**
 
 
 
• Also, we know the identity of the noun
